title: Pewter Gym & Mt. Moon
subtitle: Boulder Badge, Route 3, the Mt. Moon fossil choice, Route 4

steps.text: Recommended level for Brock: 12-14. Brock's Onix has high Defense but pitiful Special Defense; special attacks (Water Gun, Vine Whip, Confusion) hit it hard. Rock Tomb lowers your Speed.
Gym Leader Brock. Geodude Lv.12, Onix Lv.14. Win the Boulder Badge (Pokémon up to Lv.20 obey) and TM39 Rock Tomb.
Leave Pewter to the east: Oak's aide stops you and hands over the Running Shoes (hold B to run).
Route 3: a long line of trainers, good experience. Jigglypuff and Nidoran appear in the grass; Spearow → Fearow is a solid early Flying type.
Route 4 Pokémon Center (outside Mt. Moon): the Magikarp salesman sells a Lv.5 Magikarp for $500. It is a Gyarados by Lv.20, well worth it if you lack a Water type.
Mt. Moon 1F: grab the items around the edges (Moon Stone in the northwest corner). Zubat swarms; Geodude, Paras and rare Clefairy live here.
Mt. Moon B1F is a set of short tunnels linking the ladders; it has six hidden items (Itemfinder later, or press A on the spots).
Mt. Moon B2F: Team Rocket Grunts, then Super Nerd Miguel guarding two fossils.
Choose ONE fossil: Helix Fossil → Omanyte (Rock/Water, defensive) or Dome Fossil → Kabuto (Rock/Water, faster attacker). You revive it on Cinnabar Island much later.
Route 4 (east side): jump the ledges down toward Cerulean. You cannot come back up without going through Mt. Moon again.
Two Move Tutors on Route 4 (east, near the Center side): Mega Punch and Mega Kick, once each. Good on Nidoran, Mankey or Squirtle.
